sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "budget_limit_in_cents" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("type", "normalized_name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_methods" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("normalized_name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_in_cents" > 0), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payment_method_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "description" TEXT NULL, "date_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "fixed_entry_id" INTEGER NULL, "savings_goal_id" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "savings_goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_amount_in_cents" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_in_cents" > 0), "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_start_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cycle_started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "income_transaction_id" INTEGER NULL, "cycle_schedules_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "auto_close_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_close_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "auto_close_minute_of_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1260 CHECK("auto_close_minute_of_day" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_cycles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "income_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expense_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_lists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_in_cents" INTEGER NULL, "expense_transaction_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "payable_id" INTEGER NULL, "purchase_date_epoch_day" INTEGER NULL, "payment_method_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "expense_category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_list_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "shopping_list_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" >= 1), "estimated_unit_price_in_cents" INTEGER NULL, "actual_unit_price_in_cents" INTEGER NULL, "is_purchased" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_purchased" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_adjustments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "shopping_list_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_positive" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_positive" IN (0, 1)), "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_in_cents" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_payables" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "shopping_list_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES shopping_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_in_cents" > 0), "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payment_method_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "date_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_settled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_settled" IN (0, 1)), "transaction_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "obligations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "counterparty" TEXT NULL, "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_in_cents" > 0), "due_date_epoch_day" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "default_payment_method_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "source_shopping_list_id" INTEGER NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES shopping_lists (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "is_cancelled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_cancelled" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "obligation_payments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "obligation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES obligations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_in_cents" > 0), "date_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_method_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "transaction_id" INTEGER NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_in_cents" > 0), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payment_method_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "start_date_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_date_epoch_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date_epoch_day" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_methods_single_default ON payment_methods (is_default) WHERE is_default = 1
CREATE INDEX transactions_date_created_idx ON transactions (date_epoch_day, created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_category_idx ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_payment_method_idx ON transactions (payment_method_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_fixed_entry_idx ON transactions (fixed_entry_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transactions_recurring_date_unique ON transactions (fixed_entry_id, date_epoch_day)
CREATE INDEX transactions_savings_goal_idx ON transactions (savings_goal_id)
CREATE INDEX savings_goals_completed_idx ON savings_goals (completed_at)
CREATE INDEX budget_cycles_start_end_idx ON budget_cycles (start_date_epoch_day, end_date_epoch_day)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shopping_lists_expense_idx ON shopping_lists (expense_transaction_id) WHERE expense_transaction_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX shopping_list_items_list_idx ON shopping_list_items (shopping_list_id)
CREATE INDEX shopping_adjustments_list_idx ON shopping_adjustments (shopping_list_id)
CREATE INDEX obligation_payments_obligation_idx ON obligation_payments (obligation_id)
CREATE INDEX recurring_entries_active_next_idx ON recurring_entries (is_active, next_date_epoch_day)
